SimulatorBootstrapRequest.description:
Development-only software identity proof for the desktop simulator.

A physical device will later replace this proof with mTLS backed by its
secure element. Keeping this request separate prevents a simulator key
from becoming a production hardware credential by accident.
SimulatorBootstrapRequest.title: SimulatorBootstrapRequest

post.description:
Create a short-lived merchant pairing session for a software simulator.

This endpoint is explicitly disabled unless SIMULATOR_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED is
set. Production hardware will use a separate mTLS path.
